description: Live grey market premium (GMP) for Indian IPOs that are open, upcoming or awaiting listing: GMP in rupees and %, estimated listing price, overall subscription, dates, board (Mainboard/SME). GMP is the median of three public trackers, refreshed every 30 minutes from 7 AM to midnight IST.

include_listed.description: Also include IPOs listed in the last three weeks, with their listing gain.
